member.name: M:NXOpen.Display.PointCloudCollection.FindObject(System.String)
member.summary: Finds the NXOpen.Display.PointCloud with the given identifier as recorded in a journal.
member.remarks:
An object may not return the same value as its JournalIdentifier in different versions of the software. However newer versions of the software should find the same object when FindObject is passed older versions of its journal identifier. In general, this method should not be used in handwritten code and exists to support record and playback of journals.
An exception will be thrown if no object can be found with the given journal identifier.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Display.RayTracedStudioBuilder
member.summary: Represents a NXOpen.Display.RayTracedStudioBuilder .
member.remarks:
Ray Traced Studio displays CPU-based real-time ray tracing results of a model dynamically.
This class is restricted to being called from a program running during an Interactive NX session. If run from a non-interactive session it will return a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic).
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.ViewCollection.CreateRayTracedStudioBuilder

member.name: M:NXOpen.Display.TransientText.DisplayTemporaryAbsoluteGeometry(System.Int32,NXOpen.View,NXOpen.Display.TransientText.ViewType,NXOpen.DisplayableObject,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Displays text as temporary display using absolute geometry.
member.remarks:
Insure that you have set all needed properties before using this method. Note that the text will be displayed on the Absolute XY plane, and therefore will rotate as the view orientation is changed. At some view orientations the text can appear upside down or even backwards. Sizes are expressed in the units of the displayed part. See Display.TransientText.SetAbsoluteTextSize for how to set the text size. Note that the apparent size of the text is view scale dependent and therefore will appear larger or smaller on screen as the view scale is modified.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: The index of the font to be used. This may be 0, which means to use the default font.
The view in which to display the text. This may be a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), in which case the viewType argument is used.
Used only when view is a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic).

May be a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), in which case the text will be drawn at the given position. If not a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), draw the text at the attention point of object.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Display.TransientText.DisplayTemporaryScreenGeometry(System.Int32,NXOpen.View,NXOpen.Display.TransientText.ViewType,NXOpen.DisplayableObject,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Displays text as temporary display using screen geometry.
member.remarks:
Insure that you have set all needed properties before using this method. This method is not supported for 2D output such as CGM. See Display.TransientText.set_ScreenTextSize for how to adjust the size of the text. Note that the displayed text remains screen parallel and front-facing, and appears the same size regardless of view orientation or scale.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: The index of the font to be used. This may be 0, which means to use the default font.
The view in which to display the text. This may be a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), in which case the viewType argument is used.
Used only when view is a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic).

May be a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), in which case the text will be drawn at the given position. If not a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), draw the text at the attention point of object.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Display.TransientText.DisplayTemporaryAbsRotScreenSizeGeometry(System.Int32,NXOpen.View,NXOpen.Display.TransientText.ViewType,NXOpen.DisplayableObject,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Displays text as temporary display using screen geometry.
member.remarks:
The text will be displayed on the XY plane of the absolute coordinate system. Insure that you have set all needed properties before using this method. This method is not supported for 2D output such as CGM. Note that size of the text is fixed and therefore does not scale with the view. See Display.TransientText.set_ScreenTextSize for how to set the desired size. Further note that by default this screen size text is "flipped" within its bounding box if necessary to ensure the text remains readable (front facing and approximately upright).
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: The index of the font to be used. This may be 0, which means to use the default font.
The view in which to display the text. This may be a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), in which case the viewType argument is used.
Used only when view is a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic).

May be a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), in which case the text will be drawn at the given position. If not a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), draw the text at the attention point of object.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drafting.DrawingCreationWizardBuilder
member.summary: Represents a NXOpen.Drafting.DrawingCreationWizardBuilder .
member.remarks:
This class is used to create Booklets (i.e. a set of fully populated drawings). The builder operates in both create and edit modes as well as in native and managed (Teamcenter) modes. The following information is important when using this builder in edit mode:
Native Mode
The NXOpen.Drafting.DrawingCreationWizardBuilder.Folder must be the first thing set after creating the builder. Setting this will populate the builder with the booklet's information.
Managed Mode
The NXOpen.Drafting.DrawingCreationWizardBuilder.Number and NXOpen.Drafting.DrawingCreationWizardBuilder.Revision must be the first things set after creating the builder (in that order). The setting of the NXOpen.Drafting.DrawingCreationWizardBuilder.Revision will populate the builder with the booklet's information.
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drafting.AutomationManager.CreateDrawingCreationWizardBuilder Default values.

0
Created in NX8.0.0

member.remarks:

member.name: M:NXOpen.Drawings.DraftingViewCollection.FindObject(System.String)
member.summary: Finds the NXOpen.Drawings.DraftingView with the given identifier as recorded in a journal.
member.remarks:
An object may not return the same value as its JournalIdentifier in different versions of the software. However newer versions of the software should find the same object when FindObject is passed older versions of its journal identifier. In general, this method should not be used in handwritten code and exists to support record and playback of journals.
An exception will be thrown if no object can be found with the given journal identifier.
Created in NX3.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Identifier of the drafting view to be found

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.DrawingSheet
member.summary: Represents a drawing sheet.
member.remarks:
When you create a sheet using Add Child Rule in KF with the use_template option, you will need to set the option to either custom_size or standard_size afterwards. You also will need to set the scale, units, projection_angle, height, and length parameters, as these are not required when creating a sheet with a template.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drawings.DrawingSheetBuilder

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.PictorialSectionLine
member.summary: A Pictorial Simple or Pictorial Stepped Section Line.
member.remarks:
This section line is used to create either a simple or stepped section cut from a pictorial parent member view. The section line displays as a pictorial section line.
Pictorial Simple Section Line provides one cut to form a view that allows you to see the inside of a part. The view is created by dividing the part with a single cutting plane.
Pictorial Stepped Section Line lets you create a section view which contains linear steps. You can make these steps by indicating multiple cuts, bends, and arrow segments. All bend and arrow segments are created perpendicular to cut segments.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drawings.SectionLineBuilder
Created in NX6.0.0
Deprecated in NX10.0.0. Use NXOpen.Drawings.SectionViewBuilder.SectionLineType

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.PointAndAngleSectionLine
member.summary: Point and Angle Section Line lets you create a view with multiple segment cuts with no bends.
member.remarks:
The section line is defined by a set of rotation points and angles.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drawings.SectionLineBuilder

member.summary: Returns or sets the status of background.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Drawings.SectionViewStyle.CrossHatch
member.summary: Returns or sets the status of cross hatch.
member.remarks:
Allows to control whether or not crosshatching is generated in a given section view. If True, crosshatching is displayed for a section view on the drawing, else crosshatching is not generated for a section view on the drawing, and a performance increase is gained.
Created in NX5.0.0

member.name: P:NXOpen.Drawings.SectionViewStyle.HiddenLineHatching
member.summary: Returns or sets the status of hidden line hatching.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.SketchedHalfSectionLine
member.summary: Sketched Half Section Line is sketch based section line.
member.remarks:
It is used to create a view with half of the part sectioned and the other half un-sectioned. Half sections are similar to simple and stepped sections in that the cut segment is parallel to the defined hinge line. Note that the Half Section Line contains only one arrow, one bend, and one cut segment.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drawings.SketchSectionLineBuilder
Created in NX10.0.0

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.SketchedPointToPointSectionLine
member.summary: Sketched Point to Point Section Line is sketch based section line.
member.remarks:
It lets you create a view with multiple segment cuts with no bends.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drawings.SketchSectionLineBuilder
Created in NX10.0.0

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.SketchedSteppedSectionLine
member.summary: A Sketched Simple or Stepped Section Line is sketch based section line.
member.remarks:
Sketched Simple Section Line provides one cut to form a view that allows you to see the inside of a part. The view is created by dividing the part with a single cutting plane.
Stepped Section Line lets you create a section view which contains linear steps. You can make these steps by indicating multiple cuts, bends, and arrow segments. All bend and arrow segments are created perpendicular to cut segments.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Drawings.SteppedSectionLine
member.summary: A Simple or Stepped Section Line.
member.remarks:
Simple Section Line provides one cut to form a view that allows you to see the inside of a part. The view is created by dividing the part with a single cutting plane.
Stepped Section Line lets you create a section view which contains linear steps. You can make these steps by indicating multiple cuts, bends, and arrow segments. All bend and arrow segments are created perpendicular to cut segments.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Drawings.SectionViewBuilder
Created in NX6.0.0

member.name: P:NXOpen.Drawings.ThreadsViewStyle.MinimumPitchField
member.summary: Returns or sets the minimum pitch field.
member.remarks:
Allows to control the minimum distance (in drawing coordinates) to which two points which represent crests of a thread are drawn. It is also used to control the minimum distance between a thread and it's defining geometry such as edges, silhouettes or section edges of the cylindrical face or chamfered face. This can be used to help prevent lines from running together, when threads with a small pitch are plotted at a small scale.
Created in NX5.0.0

member.remarks:
If the component is not in a state to commit then an exception is thrown. For example, if the component requires you to set some property, this method will throw an exception if you haven't set it. This method throws a not yet implemented NXException for some components.
Created in NX3.0.1
License requirements: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Drawings.ViewPlacementBuilder.Offset
member.summary: Returns or sets the offset.
member.remarks:
If the lock offset flag is set to true then the offset will be applied. The offset has no meaning when used with the NXOpen.Drawings.ViewPlacementBuilder.Method.Overlay . If the NXOpen.Drawings.ViewPlacementBuilder.Method.Infer method is set, then the offset is defined as the distance from the view to its parent view. For all other methods, the offset is defined as the distance along the line being aligned to.
Created in NX6.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: drafting ("DRAFTING")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Drawings.ViewPlacementBuilder.Placement
member.summary: Returns the placement location.
member.remarks:
The location may be specified by either selecting an object of NXOpen.Point class or not selecting an object and specifying a NXOpen.Point3d selected object point. If the alignment method is set to NXOpen.Drawings.ViewPlacementBuilder.Method.Infer then the location defines the position of the view's center. The location is not necessarily the position of the view. The location provides a hint point that helps determine the view's position based on the alignment method and alignment point specified.
Created in NX6.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters
member.summary: The structure of JA faceting parameters

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.MaximumFacetEdges
member.summary: The maximum number of edges allowed in the facets that are to be generated (this does not apply to JT).

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SpecifySurfaceTolerance
member.summary: If this value is true, then values must be specified for surfaceDistanceTolerance and surfaceAngularTolerance.
member.remarks: If this value is false then values for surfaceDistanceTolerance and surfaceAngularTolerance will be determined by the system based on the body box or face box of the solid entity being faceted.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SurfaceDistanceTolerance
member.summary: This is the maximum distance from the surface to the facet.
member.remarks: The tolerance is to be specified in part units.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SurfaceAngularTolerance
member.summary: This is the maximum angular variation in radians of the surface normal over the facet.
member.remarks: A value of zero indicates no constraint. The tolerance is to be specified in radians.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SpecifyCurveTolerance
member.summary: This indicates that values are to be specified for curveDistanceTolerance and curveAngularTolerance and curve_max_length.
member.remarks: If this value is false then values for curveDistanceTolerance and curveAngularTolerance will be determined by the system based on the body box or face box of the solid entity being faceted, and no restriction will be placed on the maximum length of curve that can be represented by a single facet edge.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.CurveDistanceTolerance
member.summary: This is the maximum distance between the facet edge and the curve segment represented by the facet edge.
member.remarks: This applies only to those facet edges lying along solid edges. The tolerance is to be specified in part units.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.CurveAngularTolerance
member.summary: This is the maximum angular variation in radians of the curve tangent along the curve segment represented by the facet edge.
member.remarks: This applies only to those facet edges lying along solid edges. A value of zero indicates no constraint. The tolerance is to be specified in radians.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.CurveMaximumLength
member.summary: The maximum length of a curve, default is 1000.
member.remarks: 0 This is to be specified in part units

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SpecifyConvexFacets
member.summary: This indicates that the facets generated by the faceter should all be convex (this does not apply to JT).

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SpecifyMaximumFacetSize
member.summary: This indicates that a maximum width of facet is to be specified using maximumFacetSize.
member.remarks: If this field is false then no maximum facet size is imposed.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.MaximumFacetSize
member.summary: This is the maximum width of a facet.
member.remarks: This is only used if specifyMaximumFacetSize is true. This is to be specified in part units.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SpecifyParameters
member.summary: This indicates that the model will be created with the parametric information for each vertex.
member.remarks: Should parameters at the vertices be obtained for the facets of the model (this does not apply to JT).

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.NumberStorageType
member.summary: This indicates whether the real numbers for facet vertices and facet normals should be stored as floats (UF_FACET_TYPE_FLOAT) or as doubles (UF_FACET_TYPE_DOUBLE).
member.remarks: Note that this option applies only when a faceted model is being created, and is ignored when the model is updated. This option is not applicable to JT creation or update.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SpecifyViewDirection
member.summary: Should we use a viewing direction for denser faceting around silhouettes.
member.remarks: The denser faceting will honor the tolerance specified by silhouetteChordTolerance in the silhouette with respect to the view direction specified by silhouetteViewDirection vector. If this is false, there is no special consideration for any silhouette area (this does not apply to JT).

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SilhouetteViewDirection
member.summary: If specifyViewDirection is specified, then this is the view direction to use (this does not apply to JT).

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.SilhouetteChordTolerance
member.summary: If specifyViewDirection is specified then this is the tolerance which will be used as a tighter surface tolerance in the silhouette area specified by the view direction (this does not apply to JT).
member.remarks: The tolerance is to be specified in part units.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.StoreFaceTag
member.summary: Should this FACET body record face tags or not (this does not apply to JT).

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.FacetingParameters.WithLODS
member.summary: When creating a JT facet body whether to create LODs or not (this does not apply to NX).

member.name: M:NXOpen.Facet.FacetedBodyCollection.CreateFacetBody(NXOpen.Body[],NXOpen.Facet.FacetedBody[]@,System.Int32[]@)
member.summary: Creates a JT NXOpen.Facet.FacetedBody using the default faceting tolerances.
member.remarks:
The output facetBodies and errorTable arrays are the same size as the input nSolidBodies. The errorTable array provides information about any errors encountered when faceting bodies. Note that it is possible that faceted bodies with 0 facets are created (and returned in the facetBodies parameter). For this case, the errorTable will contain the UF_FACET_err_zero_facets_produced error. If there is an existing facet body it will get refaceted with the previous tolerance used to tessellate it . See NXOpen.Body.GetFacetedBody for ways to check for this situation.
Created in NX7.5.5
License requirements: adv_assemblies ("ADVANCED ASSEMBLIES")

member.remarks:
The output facetBodies and errorTable arrays are the same size as the input nSolidFaces. The errorTable array provides information about any errors encountered when faceting bodies. Note that it is possible that faceted bodies with 0 facets are created (and returned in the facetBodies parameter). For this case, the errorTable will contain the UF_FACET_err_zero_facets_produced error. If there is an existing facet body it will get refaceted with the previous tolerance used to tessellate it . See NXOpen.Body.GetFacetedBody for ways to check for this situation.
Created in NX8.5.0

member.summary: Represents a NXOpen.Facet.SewFacetBodyBuilder It sews two touching NX facet bodies.
member.remarks:
User need to specify the range on one of input body. The range on the other body is calculated automatically by choosing the closest vertex. It retruns a new mergered NX facet body. The two input bodies can be kept, deleted or hidden.

member.summary: Subdivision methods

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.SubdivideFacetBodyBuilder.SubdivisionMethodType.SubdivideIntoFour
member.summary: Subdivides the polygons into four sub triangles. The original mesh structure remains.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.SubdivideFacetBodyBuilder.SubdivisionMethodType.SubdividebyEdgeLength
member.summary: Subdivides the polygons to a specified edge length. The original mesh structure disappears.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Facet.SubdivideFacetBodyBuilder.InterpolationMethodType
member.summary: Subdivision interpolation methods

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.SubdivideFacetBodyBuilder.InterpolationMethodType.Linear
member.summary: In the linear option the sub-triangles are coplanar to the original triangle. Shape resolution remains untouched.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Facet.SubdivideFacetBodyBuilder.InterpolationMethodType.Cubic
member.summary: In the cubic option the sub-triangles are fitted cubic to the surrounding triangles. Shape resolution increases.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Facet.SubdivideFacetBodyBuilder.AngleThreshold
member.summary: Returns or sets the angular tolerance to detect sharp edges to be kept.
member.remarks:
Cubic interpolation can not interpolate over an edge of two triangles whose normals differ more than the specified value. Same applies to re-meshing.
Created in NX7.5.0

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.CurveFromStrokeData.DetectionSensitivityOption.Low
member.summary: For creating primitives, the strokes can have large deviations from an ideal circle, line, etc.; For creating splines, the output spline will be rather smooth with larger deviations to the stroke.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.CurveFromStrokeData.DetectionSensitivityOption.Standard
member.summary: For creating primitives, the strokes can have medium deviations from an ideal circle, line, etc.; For creating splines, the output spline will be a tradeoff between smoothness and accuracy to the stroke.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.CurveFromStrokeData.DetectionSensitivityOption.High
member.summary: For creating primitives, the strokes can have only small deviations from an ideal circle, line, etc.; For creating splines, the output spline will be rather bumpy with small deviations to the stroke.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.DrawCurveData.DetectionSensitivityOption
member.summary: Detection sensitivity options

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.DrawCurveData.DetectionSensitivityOption.Low
member.summary: For creating primitives, the strokes can have large deviations from an ideal circle, line, etc.; For creating splines, the output spline will be rather smooth with larger deviations to the stroke.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.DrawCurveData.DetectionSensitivityOption.Standard
member.summary: For creating primitives, the strokes can have medium deviations from an ideal circle, line, etc.; For creating splines, the output spline will be a tradeoff between smoothness and accuracy to the stroke.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.DrawShapes.DrawCurveData.DetectionSensitivityOption.High
member.summary: For creating primitives, the strokes can have only small deviations from an ideal circle, line, etc.; For creating splines, the output spline will be rather bumpy with small deviations to the stroke.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.AeroFlangeBuilder.SetEndCompensation(NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.AeroFlangeBuilder.EndType,NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.AeroFlangeBuilder.CompType,System.String)
member.summary: Set end compensation.
member.remarks:
This method sets the flange compensation for one end of a non-periodic Base Edge section. The end_type input parameter denotes if the end is the start of section(end1) or the end of section(end2). If the compensation type( comp_type) is either Angle or Distance, an expression for the value of compensation must be provided. This expression input can be NULL for Automatic and None type of compensations.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: aero_sheet_metal ("Aerospace Sheet Metal") OR adv_sheet_metal_dsgn ("ADVANCED SHEET METAL DESIGN")

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions
member.summary: Enum representing width option types for Bridge Transition feature.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions.Finite
member.summary: Bridge Transition starts at specified point on start edge and extends on one side by the specified distance.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions.Symmetric
member.summary: Bridge Transition starts at specified point on start edge and extends on either side by half the specified distance.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions.FullStartEdge
member.summary: Bridge Transition spans the full length of start edge.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions.FullEndEdge
member.summary: Bridge Transition spans the full length of end edge.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions.FullBothEdges
member.summary: Bridge Transition spans the full length of both the edges.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.TypeOptions
member.remarks: Enum representing types for Bridge Transition feature.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.TypeOptions.Zu
member.summary: Bridge Transition type consisting of Bend-Planar-Bend regions.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.TypeOptions.Fold
member.summary: Bridge Transition type consisting of Planar-Bend-Planar regions.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthDirectionOptions
member.summary: Enum representing the width direction for the Bridge Transition.
member.remarks: This enum applies only when the width type is Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthOptions.Finite . The Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthDirectionOptions.Right option indicates that the width is in the counter clockwise direction of flow of the start edge in the non-thickness face adjacent to it. The Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthDirectionOptions.Left option indicates the width is in the opposite direction.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthDirectionOptions.Left
member.summary: It means Bridge Transition width direction at point specified and fin direction are in opposite direction.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.WidthDirectionOptions.Right
member.summary: It means Bridge Transition width direction at point specified and fin direction are in same direction.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.InsetOptions
member.summary: Enum representing the side of the Bridge Transition material with respect to the specified tangent plane.
member.remarks: If it is Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.InsetOptions.MaterialInside then the transtion and start edge flow will be on the same logical side of the plane. If they are on opposite sides then use Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.InsetOptions.MaterialOutside .

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.InsetOptions.MaterialInside
member.summary: Bridge Transition body near tangential plane and start will be on same side of the tangential plane selected.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.InsetOptions.MaterialOutside
member.summary: Bridge Transition body near tangential plane and start will be on opposite sides of the tangential plane selected.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.FoldTransitionTypeOptions
member.summary: Enum representing the type of Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.TypeOptions.Fold .
member.remarks: Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.TypeOptions.Fold can be defined by Length or Bend.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.FoldTransitionTypeOptions.Length
member.summary: Fold Transition type is Length.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.FoldTransitionTypeOptions.Bend
member.summary: Fold Transition type is Bend.

member.summary: Returns or sets the option to get an alternate solution for the Features.SheetMetal.BridgeTransitionBuilder.FoldTransitionTypeOptions.Bend when the width option is finite or symmetric.

remarks.para: If there is only one working solution possible then this method will not do anything.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.ContourFlangeBuilder.SectionSideOptions
member.summary: This enum represents the side of the section in which material is created.
member.remarks: The "left" option represents the side to the left of a person who is walking along the section in the direction of its curves when the section normal is pointing up. The "right" option represents the person's right hand side. This interpretation is the same regardless of whether the section is open or closed. The "right" side at any point along the section can also be represented by the vector resulting from the cross product of the curve tangent (of the section curve at that point) and the section normal. The "left" side is the opposite.

member.summary: This enum represents the side of the section that the dimple punches material.
member.remarks: The "left" option represents the side to the left of a person who is walking along the section in the direction of its curves when the section normal is pointing up. The "right" option represents the person's right hand side. This interpretation is the same regardless of whether the section is open or closed. The "right" side at any point along the section can also be represented by the vector resulting from the cross product of the curve tangent (of the section curve at that point) and the section normal. The "left" side is the opposite.

member.summary: Returns or sets the Offset Dimension.
member.remarks:
For NX1872 or later Dimple features this option will always be NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.DimensionTypeOptions.Full .
The actual extent distance of the Dimple will be determined by the active dimension option. In case of NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.DimensionTypeOptions.Offset the actual extent distance will be offset dimension distance plus the thickness of sheet. In case of NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.DimensionTypeOptions.Full the actual extent distance will be the Full dimension distance.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.MinimumToolClearance
member.summary: Returns the minimum tool clearance expression.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.Section
member.summary: Returns or sets the Section used by the Dimple.
member.remarks:
Section can be Open/Closed.
The section is protruded on the reference face at finite distance of extent and in the direction of extent side. The actual extent distance will be determined by the active dimension option i.e. Offset Dimension or Full Dimension. In case of Offset Dimension the actual extent distance will be offset dimension distance plus the thickness of sheet. In case of Full Dimension the actual extent distance will be the Full dimension distance. In case of open section, the end segments are extended to the nearest flat face edges. If the end segments are already crossing the flat face edges, those segments will be trimmed to the edges.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements to get this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal")
License requirements to set this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.SectionSide
member.summary: Returns or sets the section Side for the Dimple section.

remarks.para: This is used to specify which side of the section should remain stationary during the Dimple operation. Dimple's section is a set of connected curves. The material exists on both sides of the section curves. section Side specifies - the material on which side of the curve must be punched.The other side shall be bent to the specified angle with respect to this fixed side. This is how you calculate Left/Right. Get the Section Normal (N)Get the Tangent of the section.(T) Result = CrossProduct(N, T). The resultant vector is called RIGHT. This vector shall be in the direction of one if the two sides of the material.If you want the material on the side of Result to be punched, then you have to pass the value of NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.SectionSideOptions.Right If you want the other side to be punched, then you have to send NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.SectionSideOptions.Left .
License requirements to get this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal")
License requirements to set this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.SidewallType
member.summary: Returns or sets the side where the material must be added to the dimple.
member.remarks:
Done with Respect to the section
If NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.SidewallTypeOptions.Inside is specified, the material of the dimple sidewalls will be added to the interior of the section. If NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DimpleBuilder.SidewallTypeOptions.Outside is specified,the material will be added from the lifted section such that the volume of the dimple cavity is increased.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements to get this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal")
License requirements to set this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal")

remarks.para: If the Sketch is created internally as part of the Dimple command in the UI, then it shall be consumed by the Dimple and shall not show up as a separate feature in the Part Navigator. If such a behaviour is desired, then specify the Sketch here.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DrawnCutoutBuilder.SidewallType
member.summary: Returns or sets the side where the material must be added to the Drawn Cutout.
member.remarks:
Done with Respect to the section
If NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DrawnCutoutBuilder.SidewallTypeOptions.Inside is specified, the material of the drawn cutout sidewalls will be added to the interior of the section. If NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.DrawnCutoutBuilder.SidewallTypeOptions.Outside is specified,the material will be added from the lifted section such that the volume of the drawn cutout cavity is increased.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.LengthType
member.summary: Returns or sets a enum indicating the length type.
member.remarks:
For Features created in NX8 and above: The way length is measured for the flange. It can either be measure from the inside edge or the outside edge.
Flange length can be specified starting from the selected edge or from the corresponding edge on the other face (other linear edge on the other side of the thickness face). If the length is specified from the selected edge use value NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.LengthTypeOptions.InsideDimension or if the flange length is specifed from the other edge use value NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.LengthTypeOptions.OutsideDimension .
For Features created in NX8 and above: Flange length can be measure from the Inner Mold Line, Outer Mold Line or Bend Tangent Line.
Inner Mold Line: Intersection of inner tab face and inner flange web face Outer Mold Line: Intersection of outer tab face and outer flange web face Bend Tangent Line: common edge between flange web face and bend face.
Flange length can be specified starting from the inner mold line or outer mold line or bend tangent line. If the length is specified from the inner mold line use value NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.LengthTypeOptions.InsideDimension or if the flange length is specifed from the outer mold line use value NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.LengthTypeOptions.OutsideDimension or if the flange length is specifed from the bend tangent line use value NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.LengthTypeOptions.WebDimension .
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements to get this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal") OR nx_flexible_pcb ("NX Flexible PCB") OR nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")
License requirements to set this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal") OR nx_flexible_pcb ("NX Flexible PCB") OR nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthType
member.summary: Returns or sets the width type for flange.

remarks.para:
Use one of the values from NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions . Depending on which of the values from the enum is used, none, either or both of the distance values from NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.FirstDistance and NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance may be used. Here is a description of the distances:
If the value is NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions.FullEdge , then both the FirstDistance and NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance values are unused.
If the value is NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions.CenterOfEdge , then both the NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.FirstDistance and NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance represent exactly half the width of the flange.
If the value is NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions.AtEdgeEnd , then NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.FirstDistance represents the width of the flange, starting from the end of the edge specified by the NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.Vertex and the NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance is not used.
If the value is NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions.FromEdgeEnd , then NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.FirstDistance represents the distance of the start point of the flange from the end of the edge specified by NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.Vertex and NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance represents the width of the flange.
If the value is NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions.FromBothEnds , then NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.FirstDistance represents the distance of the start point of the flange from the from the end of the edge specified by NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.Vertex and NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance represents the distance of the end point of the flange from end of the edge opposite to the end specified by NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.Vertex .
The value NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.WidthTypeOptions.Custom , cannot be set by the user. It is set internally if the sketch for the flange has been edited after creation. In this case, the expressions NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.FirstDistance and NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlangeBuilder.SecondDistance may or may not retain their original meaning when the flange was first created, so the user should not rely on these any more to mean anything specific.
License requirements to get this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal") OR nx_flexible_pcb ("NX Flexible PCB") OR nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")
License requirements to set this property: nx_sheet_metal ("NX Sheet Metal") OR nx_flexible_pcb ("NX Flexible PCB") OR nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlexibleCableBuilder.BendAngleDirectionOptions
member.summary: This enum represents the bend angle direction for the bend segment.
member.remarks: First member of the cable is always a planar segment. For this, the normal direction for bend angle is opposite to the thickness direction. This convention continues untill a fold (bend type having nonzero path adjustment angle) is placed. After this, the convention reverses, meaning the normal direction for the bend angle is along the thickness direction. For each member, the thickness direction signifies the material addition direction. This is an input for the entire cable at the start.

member.summary: Bend angle reverse normal direction.

member.summary: Bend angle normal direction.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.FlexibleCableBuilder.PathAdjustmentAngleDirectionOptions
member.summary: This enum represents the path adjustment angle direction for the bend segment.
member.remarks: The cross product of the cable direction and the bend angle direction determined using above convention gives the right direction for the path adjustment angle. The left direction is opposite to that.

member.summary: jog created on the side of the section normal.

member.summary: jog created on the side opposite to that of the section normal

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.JogBuilder.FixedSideOptions
member.summary: The "left" option represents the side to the left of a person who is walking along the section in the direction of its curves when the section normal is pointing up.
member.remarks: The "right" option represents the person's right hand side. This interpretation is the same regardless of whether the section is open or closed. The "right" side at any point along the section can also be represented by the vector resulting from the cross product of the curve tangent (of the section curve at that point) and the section normal. The "left" side is the opposite.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.JogBuilder.FixedSideOptions.SectionSideLeft
member.summary: Side pointed to by the inverse of the tangent cross normal vector

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.JogBuilder.FixedSideOptions.SectionSideRight
member.summary: Side pointed to by the tangent cross normal vector

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.LoftedFlangeBuilder.SectionSideOptions
member.summary: This enum represents the side of the section that the lofted flange creates thickness.
member.remarks: The "left" option represents the side to the left of a person who is walking along the section in the direction of its curves when the section normal is pointing up. The "right" option represents the person's right hand side. This interpretation is the same regardless of whether the section is open or closed. The "right" side at any point along the section can also be represented by the vector resulting from the cross product of the curve tangent (of the section curve at that point) and the section normal. The "left" side is the opposite.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.MiterOptions.UseNormalCutoutMethod
member.summary: Returns or sets the cut type of the sheet.
member.remarks:
If set to true, mitering is done using the normal cutout method and aims to reduce the small segements that result as part of miter computation, and is carried out on an unbent sheet. Normally, the cut runs through from one bend centre to another. The sheet is later bent to achieve the desired result. This option is not applicable for feature created in NX1926 and above and set method will not do any operation
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: None.

member.summary: Material removed on the side of the section normal.

member.summary: Material removed on the side opposite to that of the section normal

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.NormalCutoutBuilder.DepthSideOptions.Symmetric
member.summary: Material removed in both directions equally. Only applies when the depth type is NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.NormalCutoutBuilder.DepthTypeOptions.Finite .

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.NormalCutoutBuilder.SectionSideOptions
member.summary: This enum represents the side of the section that the normal cutout removes material.
member.remarks: The "left" option represents the side to the left of a person who is walking along the section in the direction of its curves when the section normal is pointing up. The "right" option represents the person's right hand side. This interpretation is the same regardless of whether the section is open or closed. The "right" side at any point along the section can also be represented by the vector resulting from the cross product of the curve tangent (of the section curve at that point) and the section normal. The "left" side is the opposite.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.NormalCutoutBuilder.SectionSideOptions.Left
member.summary: Side pointed to by the inverse of the tangent cross normal vector

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.NormalCutoutBuilder.SectionSideOptions.Right
member.summary: Side pointed to by the tangent cross normal vector

member.summary: Material created on the side opposite to that of the section normal

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.TabBuilder.SectionSideOptions
member.summary: This enum represents the side of the section that the dimple punches material.
member.remarks: The "left" option represents the side to the left of a person who is walking along the section in the direction of its curves when the section normal is pointing up. The "right" option represents the person's right hand side. This interpretation is the same regardless of whether the section is open or closed. The "right" side at any point along the section can also be represented by the vector resulting from the cross product of the curve tangent (of the section curve at that point) and the section normal. The "left" side is the opposite.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.TabBuilder.SectionSideOptions.Left
member.summary: Side pointed to by the inverse of the tangent cross normal vector

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.TabBuilder.SectionSideOptions.Right
member.summary: Side pointed to by the tangent cross normal vector

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.ThreeBendCornerBuilder
member.summary: The Three Bend Corner feature class.
member.remarks:
Users can identify multiple input face pairs for each three bend corner feature. Each pair is made up of one face each from adjacent bends. The bends must both have the same radius and sweep angle, and they must also be connected via another adjoining bend.
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.SheetMetal.SheetmetalManager.CreateThreeBendCornerFeatureBuilder
Created in NX4.0.0

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AttachmentDirection
member.summary: Returns or sets the install direction on attachment face.
member.remarks:
The attachment direction defines which side the bracket is attached to the attachment face. You can either place the bracket on the attachment face normal side or the opposite side. The install directions are ship orientations based on the attachment face normal. For example: If the attachment face normal is in 'For' direction, then you should set the install direction to either 'For' or 'Aft'.
It is only used in Ship Structure Basic Design Application.
It is only used when NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentType is set to Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentTypes.DatumPlaneAlignment .
Created in NX11.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: nx_ship_basic ("Ship Basic Design") OR nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AttachmentFace
member.summary: Returns the attachment face.
member.remarks:
The attachment face defines the faces which the bracket is attached to. You can attach the bracket to more than one faces.
The attachment face is only used when NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentType is set to Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentTypes.DatumPlaneAlignment .
Created in NX11.0.0
License requirements: None.

It is only used when NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentType is set to Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentTypes.AutoAlignment .

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.PickPointOnAttachment
member.summary: Returns or sets the pick point on attachment face.
member.remarks:
When the attachment face is curved (such as a cylindrical face), the bracket can be placed at multiple locations, then the pick point is used. The position which is closest to the pick point is used.
It is optional. If there are multiple candidate locations and this is not set, a random location is chosen.
It is only used when NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentType is set to Features.ShipDesign.BracketBuilder.AlignmentTypes.DatumPlaneAlignment .

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder
member.summary: Represents a NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder .
member.remarks:
This class is used to define a drawing part in Ship Section Drawing command, in this case user can define the drawing part manually as he want. Originally, we use a NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionDrawingBuilder class and a list of NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionViewBuilder and the command will calculate the arrangement (like how many drawing parts/draw sheets need to create and which view in which sheet ) automatically. User can't define which view in which sheet.
In this project we make user has ability to define the arrangement in a tree like Drawing Part1 |- Drawing Sheet1 |-View1 |-View2 |- Drawing Sheet2 |- View3 |- View4 Drawing Part2 | - Drawing Sheet1 |- View5 |- View6
So we add NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder and NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingSheetBuilder between them and make them has structure as below: NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionDrawingBuilder NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingSheetBuilder NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionViewBuilder
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionDrawingBuilder.CreateDrawingPartBuilder
Created in NX12.0.0

User can't define which view in which sheet.
In this project we make user has ability to define the arrangement in a tree like Drawing Part1 |- Drawing Sheet1 |-View1 |-View2 |- Drawing Sheet2 |- View3 |- View4 Drawing Part2 | - Drawing Sheet1 |- View5 |- View6
So we add NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder and NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingSheetBuilder between them and make them has structure as below: NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionDrawingBuilder NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingSheetBuilder NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SectionViewBuilder
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.DrawingPartBuilder.CreateDrawingSheetBuilder
Created in NX12.0.0

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.SelectionTypes
member.summary: This enum defines the Placement Face and Placement Edge Selection Type.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.SelectionTypes.FacesWithAttributes
member.summary:
If this Selection Type is set, just faces need to be specifed and placement edges will be inferred automatically.
All faces specified as placement faces must have valid attributes that identify it as a valid face for Endcuts.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.SelectionTypes.FaceAndEdge
member.summary: If this Selection Type is set, then a single pair of a Face (Placement Face) and an edge(Placement Edge) needs to be specified.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes
member.summary: This enum defines the different ways users can trim the ends of a profile or a plate.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes.Value
member.summary: If this Limit Type is set, the values of Tilt Angle and Shear Angle expressions will be used.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes.Plane
member.summary: If this Limit Type is set, a Plane needs to be specified and the Tilt and Shear angles will be inferred from the intersection of Datum Plane with the body on which EndCut will be applied.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes.NeatTrim
member.summary: If this Limit Type is set, a datum plane feature, a face or a profile/plate body needs to be selected and the endcut will be trimmed to the selected geometry.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.DraftTypes
member.summary: This enum defines the types of draft to be applied.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.DraftTypes.Trim
member.summary: If this Draft Type is set, the EndCut face will split and the left side face will be tapered.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.DraftTypes.Extend
member.summary: If this Draft Type is set, the EndCut face will split and the right side face will be tapered.

remarks.para: This enum defines the different ways a limiting geometry can connect to the endcut face. This value can be used in rules to control the available section types for the flange, web or toe cuts. These values are applicable only when the Limit Type is NeatTrim.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.ConnectionTypes.Connected
member.summary: If this Connection Type is set, the offset parameter will be ignored.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.ConnectionTypes.FlangeFree
member.summary: If this Connection Type is set, the offset parameter will be ignored.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.ConnectionTypes.Sniped
member.summary: If this Connection Type is set, the offset parameter can be used.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.ConnectionTypes.SnipedSquare
member.summary: If this Connection Type is set, the offset parameter can be used.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.ConnectionTypes.None
member.summary: If this Connection Type is set, the offset parameter can be used.

remarks.para: This enum controls if the end face is orthogonal to the mold face of the target. This option will be used only when a boundary is selected and is applied to the face connected to the boundary. If the target has a flange and the end face is connected to the flange, this option will not be used.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.EndFaceTypes.SquareCut
member.summary: The end face will be orthogonal to the mold face of the target.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.EndFaceTypes.NeatTrim
member.summary: The end face will match the boundary face.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.InheritParametersFromEndcutFace(NXOpen.Face)
member.summary: Copy the parameters from the endcut face to this endcut.
member.remarks:
The input face must belong to an endcut feature and should have all the attributes. All the builder parameters will be replaced with copies of parameters from the input face. If any change is made after this call, the copied parameter value will be overwritten.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements: nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.summary: Update context entity for each sketch data builder, and update rules input.

remarks.para: License requirements: nx_ship_basic ("Ship Basic Design") OR nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.ConnectionType
member.summary: Returns or sets the connection type.

remarks.para: If the Limit Type is NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes.NeatTrim , users can define the connection type between the endcut face and the limiting geometry. Users can control the available flange, web or toe section types using the connection type in the rules.
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.DraftAngle
member.summary: Returns the draft angle

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.DraftOffset
member.summary: Returns the draft offset.
member.remarks:
This is the distance from the end of the Placement Edge where the Stiffener end face will be split.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.DraftType
member.summary: Returns or sets the draft type.
member.remarks:
A partial taper can be applied to the end face of a Stiffener. The end face will be split and the Draft Type defines which split face is tapered.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.EndFaceType
member.summary: Returns or sets the end face type.

remarks.para: If a boundary is specified, the end face that touuches boundary can match the boundary or be orthogonal to the mold face of the target. If a web sketch is used, this option is applied to the face generated by the curve with MK_TYPE=TAPER attribute. If no web sketch is applicable, the original end face face will be modified.
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.FlangeBoundary
member.summary: Returns the flange boundary.

remarks.para: This input is required when the Limit Type is NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes.NeatTrim . Only a single body may be specified and it must have at least one face with MK_TYPE=MOLDINGLINE and one face with MK_TYPE=OPPOSINGMOLDINGLINE attributes. This input is applicable only when an endcut is applied to a Builtup stiffener. It will be ignored for all other cases. This input will let users define a plate or a stiffener without flange as a limit geometry and specify an edge reinforcement as a flange boundary. Users can also specify a plate as a flange boundary.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.FlangeSketchData
member.summary: Returns the flange sketch data.

remarks.para: Users can specify the EndCut using upto three sketches. The sketch type and its parameters are controlled by the NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SteelFeatureSpreadsheetBuilder .

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitGeometry
member.summary: Returns the limit geometry.

remarks.para: This input is required when the Limit Type is NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitTypes.NeatTrim . Valid types are Plane, Face or a Body. If a Body is specified, it must have at least one face with MK_TYPE=MOLDINGLINE and one face with MK_TYPE=OPPOSINGMOLDINGLINE attributes.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.LimitType
member.summary: Returns or sets the limit type.
member.remarks:
The Tilt and Shear angles can be supplied as expressions or can be inferred from a Plane. Users can also limit the ends using a face or a body.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: nx_ship_detail ("Ship Detail Design")

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.Offset
member.summary: Returns the offset.
member.remarks:
The Offset is always applied after the Tilt and Shear Angles.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.PlacementEdge
member.summary: Returns the select placement edges.

remarks.para: This input is only required when the Selection Type is NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.SelectionTypes.FaceAndEdge . This edge must belong to the face specified as Placement Face.

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.PlacementFaces
member.summary: Returns the select placement faces.

remarks.para: If the Selection Type is NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.SelectionTypes.FacesWithAttributes this list can contain multiple faces and each face must be a valid endcut face, i.e. faces with SAW_SIZE and SAW_SIZE2 attributes whose value is same as the Perpendicular EndCut Name defined in the customer defaults. If the Selection Type is NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.EndCutBuilder.SelectionTypes.FaceAndEdge , this list must contain a single face. Each face will result in a separate EndCut feature. If an existing EndCut feature is queried, it will contain a single face in this list.

member.summary: Returns the profile bodies to create Inverse Bending Lines on.

remarks.para:
The list can be populated in any one of the following ways:
If the list of profile bodies is empty, the function will search the current workset for any bent profiles. For each profile that does not have an Inverse Bending Lines feature, a new one is created. A profile that already has an Inverse Bending Lines feature associated to it, is edited with the new parameters.
If the list contains one or more profiles and no feature is given, an Inverse Bending Lines features will be created or edited for each profile in the list.
If a feature is supplied to be edited, the list must contain a single bent profile that resides in the same design element as the feature.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.PlateSystemBuilder.CreateRegionBody
member.summary: Create the region body that has the inscribed boundaries.
member.remarks:
The region body is used to select the regions that are kept for the final plate system shape. Any region body created should be deleted by using the method NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.PlateSystemBuilder.DeleteRegionBody . If a region body is created when there is already a current region body, that current region body will be deleted. When the builder is committed, the region point coordinates from method NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.PlateSystemBuilder.SetRegionPoints will be used to identify the regions desired.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ProfileCutout
member.summary: Represents a profile cutout feature for NX8.
member.remarks:
Since new NX8 stiffener has been implemented with spreadsheet driven technology, the Profile Cutout feature requires improvement to take advantage of the spreadsheet driven capabilities and be compatible with the Stiffener and other NX8 Ship Structure commands. NX8 Profile Cutout feature will use spreadsheet block to replace the previous version (NX75) sketch expression modifier block
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ProfileCutoutBuilder

member.name: M:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ProfileCutoutBuilder.FindOrientation
member.summary: This method will find out the profile cutout orientation.
member.remarks:
This information will be used for drawing automation to draw the profile cutout symbol, when the profile cutout was created by flip then the symbol should be drawn flip also. So this method can be used to indicate whether the profile cuotut was created by flip or not. The logic is: The target plate shuold have the start/end flag(by seeing the End cut face attributes) and the profile(profile cutout created based on)'s molding line face is more nearing to the start of the plate, then this method will return Normal, or Flipped. if the targe plate doens't have any flag of start/end, then None will be returned.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.Types
member.summary: The option for the type of manufacturing operation to be performed on the sheet to form it.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.Types.Manual
member.summary: Creates a single line on the surface where the maximum force is to be applied.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.Types.Pressure
member.summary: Create multiple lines on the surface where the tangential for each line is constant on intersecting plane sections.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.Types.Geodesic
member.summary: Create a single geodesic line on the surface.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.Types.SteppedPressure
member.summary: Create a saw tooth set of curves on the surface where the tangential for each line is constant on intersecting plane sections.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.StartEvaluationTypes
member.summary: The option for how the starting point for the evaluation of the sheet is to be created if it is not given.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.StartEvaluationTypes.SheetMidpoint
member.summary: Use the midpoint of the sheet as the seed point for evaluation.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.StartEvaluationTypes.PointOnFace
member.summary: Use a point on the selected face to start the evaluation.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.StartEvaluationTypes.NewPoint
member.summary: Use the newly created, or specified, point as the seed point to start the evaluation.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes
member.summary: The option to specify the method for creation of the pressure line.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.MarchingAngle
member.summary: Use an initial value method and march along the varying normals at each subsequent location.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.MarchingCurvature
member.summary: Use an initial value method and march along the varying normals at each subsequent location adjusting the final direction by the sheet curvature.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.ParallelPlane
member.summary: Use a parallel plane approach to develop the pressure line.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.MinimumCurvature
member.summary: Use an initial value method and march along the minimum curvature at each subsequent location.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.MaximumCurvature
member.summary: Use an initial value method and march along the maximum curvature at each subsequent location.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.Highlight
member.summary: Use an initial value method and march along the highlight (zero degree isocline) at each subsequent location.

member.name: F:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.RollingLineBuilder.ConstructionMethodTypes.Asymptote
member.summary: Use an initial value method and march along and create the asymptotic lines. Valid for a surface location that generates a hyperbole or parabola.

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.Seam
member.summary: Represents a ship design seam feature.
member.remarks:
A seam is a Scantling, Erection, Straking or Intersection type. Seams are represented with curves on plate systems, and points on profile systems. Scantling seams indicate divisions in ship structure where differing stock definitions are needed. Erection seams indicate divisions in ship structure at manufacturing block boundaries. Straking seams indicate divisions in ship structure to make it a manufacturable size. Intersection seams indicate divisions in ship structure where other structure intersects the given structure. Although Scantling seam is the name given to seams that allow for changing stock definitions, all seam types except straking seams allow for a change in the stock definition.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SeamBuilder
Created in NX8.0.0

member.name: P:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.SeamBuilder.Type
member.summary: Returns or sets the type of seam being created.
member.remarks:
Scantling, Erection, Straking or Intersection. Scantling seams indicate divisions in ship structure where differing stock definitions are needed. Erection seams indicate divisions in ship structure at manufacturing block boundaries. Straking seams indicate divisions in ship structure to make it a manufacturable size. Intersection seams indicate divisions in ship structure where other structure intersects the given structure. Although Scantling seam is the name given to seams that allow for changing stock definitions, all seam types except straking seams allow for a change in the stock definition.
Created in NX8.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: nx_ship_basic ("Ship Basic Design")

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ShellTemplate
member.summary: Represents a shell template feature.
member.remarks:
The template is made up of a grid of sheets, or thin solids, that would physically sit on the floor and the ship shell (typically the hull) would be placed on top of the templates to measure and verify the shape of the shell. The physical fixture eventually created in the manufacturing environment may be framed inside (or together) with a box.
To create or edit an instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ShellTemplateBuilder
Created in NX8.0.0

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ShellTemplateBuilder
member.summary: Used to edit or create a NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ShellTemplate feature.
member.remarks:
The shell templates are defined on a surface by specifying a primary orientation coordinate system. The orientation coordinate system is then used to build, or filter, planes used to locate each individual template. There are 2 primary methods for defining the input. Manual allows for specific, selected, data to limit various aspects of the build (for example, build with only 1 plane). Inferred allows for the tools to generate data, thus building with a minimal of predefined input data.
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.Features.ShipCollection.CreateShellTemplateBuilder Default values.
Property Value
CornerCutType
None
CreateSeparateParts
0

0 (millimeters part), 0 (inches part)
EndYTemplateOffset.Value
0 (millimeters part), 0 (inches part)

None

member.name: T:NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ShipNameFieldBuilder
member.summary: A field, combined with other fields, to generate a name for a Ship Basic Design Object such as a Deck.
member.remarks:
The ShipNameFieldBuilder class contains the information used to generate a name for a Basic Design object, such as a Deck, Bulkhead, Stiffener System, etc.
Fields can be one of four types: 1) Fixed A string with an unchangeable value 2) Any A user entered string value 3) Option A predefined set of strings from which the user can choose one 4) Index A system generated, leading zeros, number which pretends to provide name uniqueness.
There may be as many Fixed, Any, and Option fields as the user deems appropriate. There may be only one Index field.
The fields for a particular Ship object type NXOpen.Features.ShipDesign.ShipNamesBuilder are defined in a "recipes" file which specifies, for a particular object type, the fields and their values. See ShipNamesRecipes.xml in UGII_BASE_DIR/nxship/data for details on the recipes.
A sample recipe might be defined having the following fields:
Type Value -------- -------- Fixed "TBH-" Option "Port", "Starboard", "None" Fixed "-" Index nnnnnn
This is an abstract class and cannot be instantiated
Created in NX9.0.2
