member.name: M:NXOpen.Sketch.Reattach(NXOpen.ISurface,NXOpen.IReferenceAxis,NXOpen.Vector3d,NXOpen.AxisOrientation,NXOpen.Sense,NXOpen.PlaneNormalOrientation,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Reattaches a sketch.

remarks.para: Deprecated in NX11.0.0. Use NXOpen.SketchInPlaceBuilder instead.
License requirements: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR drafting ("DRAFTING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")

member.param: A face or datum plane that the sketch will be attached to. Must be planar.

Can be a datum axis, edge, datum plane, face, or a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic). If it is an edge, the edge must be a line segment. If it is a face, the face must be a plane. If a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), the reference_direction is used instead.

If reference_axis is a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic), this parameter sets the reference direction of the sketch. In this case, this parameter must not be (0,0,0). If reference_axis is not a null reference (Nothing in Visual Basic) and this parameter is not (0,0,0), this parameter determines whether the reference direction should be in the same direction as reference_axis or in the opposite direction. If this parameter is (0,0,0), this parameter is not used.
Indicates whether the reference axis is horizontal or vertical.

Ignored unless reference_direction is (0,0,0) and reference_axis is an edge or datum axis. This parameter indicates whether the reference axis should be in the same direction as reference_axis or in the opposite direction.
Whether the sketch's Z-axis should be outward or inward.
Origin of the sketch's local coordinate system.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Sketch.AddGeometry(NXOpen.Curve,NXOpen.Sketch.InferConstraintsOption,NXOpen.Sketch.AddEllipseOption)
member.summary: Adds a curve or point to a sketch.

remarks.para: License requirements: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR drafting ("DRAFTING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")

member.param: Must be a curve or point

Whether to automatically create coincident constraints when adding the geometry. If this flag is true and there exists another curve or point in the sketch that has a vertex that is at the same location (within system tolerance) as one of the vertices for crv, a coincident constraint will be created

If you are adding an ellipse to the sketch, this parameter indicates whether the ellipse should be treated as an ellipse or general conic. If you are not adding an ellipse, the option is ignored. See the documentation for NXOpen.Sketch.AddEllipseOption for more details. The default value is NXOpen.Sketch.AddEllipseOption.TreatAsEllipse . In order to treat an ellipse as a conic, its end angle minus its start angle must be less than 180 degrees.

Indicates whether the input curves should get trimmed by the fillet

member.name: M:NXOpen.Sketch.ConvertRadialDimension(NXOpen.DisplayableObject[])
member.summary: Convert radius to diameter dimensions or diameter to radius dimensions.
member.remarks:
When the dimension is a driving dimension and its expression is referenced by another expression or its value is a formula that references expressions, then the conversion would do nothing. When converting radius to diameter, the radius value would double to diameter value. When converting diameter to radius, the diameter value would halve to radius value.

member.name: T:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder
member.summary: The NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder is used to move sketch geometry while honoring found and persistent relations.
member.remarks:
The geometry to move should be added to the builder using NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetDragGeometry . The movement of the geometry is defined by two points, which could be cursor positions. The initial point is set in NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.InitializeDrag . The geometry is transformed to a new location using NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DragToPoint . Various other options are available to change the drag behavior. See NXOpen.Sketch.RotateDragMode to enable rotate drag about the point set by NXOpen.Sketch.SetRotationOrigin , these should be executed before the drag is started by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.InitializeDrag
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.SketchCollection.CreateDragGeometryBuilder
Created in NX1980.0.0

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.GetDragGeometry(NXOpen.Sketch.SketchGeometry[]@)
member.summary: Get the geometry set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetDragGeometry .

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetDragGeometry(NXOpen.Sketch.SketchGeometry[])
member.summary: Set the geometry that will be dragged.
member.remarks:
It can include entire curves, points, or control points. All the geometry must come from the active sketch. The geometry will move as a whole rigid collection, though end points may slide along curves if they are not also explicitly included as drag geometry. The drag geometry should be set before the drag is started by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.InitializeDrag and not changed during the drag solving.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.InitializeDrag(NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Begin the drag operation from the initial point.
member.remarks:
The geometry being dragged has to be set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetDragGeometry , and other options should be set, before the drag is initialized. The initial point should lie on the sketch plane and could represent the cursor position.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: The starting point of the drag operation, used as a base point in all calls to NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DragToPoint .

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapTarget(NXOpen.NXObject)
member.summary: Set the input geometry as a snap target.
member.remarks:
It can be sketch geometry or geometry outside sketch. Relationships will be inferred between the geometry set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapGeometry and the snap targets starting from the most recent target set. The five most recent snap targets will be considered during a call to NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DragToPoint . The targets can change during the drag operation. Snap targets cannot be the geometries being dragged or geometries that are also moving because of the drag. For point snapping, such as dragging an end point onto other geometry, when the snap target is off the sketch plane use NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapPointTarget instead.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Candidate snap target geometry that is not moving with the drag operation.

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapPointTarget(NXOpen.NXObject,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Set a geometry as a snap target with help point.
member.remarks:
The geometry will be considered a snap target just like those set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapTarget . The help point is the location specified on the snap target geometry and is the point nearest to the current cursor location. The help point will be used in point snapping, such as when dragging a point of the drag geometry onto the snap target and is only necessary when the target is on a different plane than the sketch. The snap target will also be used for other relation types. Only one snap target can have a help point, and all previously set help points will be ignored though the snap targets will still be considered. While a valid help point is set and point snap to the target occurs, the new position in NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DragToPoint will have no effect. The help point can be reset by calling NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapTarget on the same geometry.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Candidate snap target geometry that is not moving with the drag operation.
The help point is used for point snapping and doesn't affect directional snapping.

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DragToPoint(NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Solve the drag operation that moves the original geometry from the initial point to the new position.
member.remarks:
If NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapEnabled is true and set up properly, geometric relationships can be inferred. Only the relationships inferred in the last call to this method will be preserved.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: The new point used to calculate the transform to apply to the drag geometry.

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DetachGeometry
member.summary: Detach all drag geometry from any relations, constraints, and dimensions.
member.remarks:
This can be called anytime after NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.InitializeDrag . Thereafter, only the drag geometry will move in this operation. Persistent relations and dimensions may be deleted to enable the drag geometry to move independent of other geometry.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapEnabled
member.summary: Returns or sets the option to enable snapping, which is inferring geometric relationships between geometry, during the next call to NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.DragToPoint .
member.remarks:
Snapping is enabled by default and uses the distance set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapRadius , the geometry set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapGeometry , and the snap candidate geometry set by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapTarget . This option can be used at any time during the drag operation.
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapGeometry
member.summary: Returns or sets the geometry that is being dragged that will be used to infer relationships with the snap targets.
member.remarks:
This geometry must be already designated as drag geometry by NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetDragGeometry . See also NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapEnabled and NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapTarget .
Created in NX1980.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapRadius
member.summary: Returns or sets the maximum distance from the drag point, or a snap help point, to a snap target for point snapping to happen.
member.remarks:
This can be adjusted based on the zoom scale to get finer control over the snapping behavior. See also NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapEnabled , NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SnapGeometry , and NXOpen.SketchDragGeometryBuilder.SetSnapTarget .

member.name: T:NXOpen.SketchEvaluator
member.summary: Represents a sketch-on-path evaluator.
member.remarks:
It allows an application to evaluate * a section and a sketch-on-path at specific path locations.
To create a new instance of this class, use NXOpen.SketchEvaluatorCollection.Create
Created in NX4.0.1

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchEvaluator.EvaluateOneSketch(System.Double)
member.summary: Work-horse method that evaluates the master section and its sketch on path * at a specific path location.
member.remarks:
* * Pre-conditions : * [1] A master section must have been registered with call to mutator set_section() * or the sketch evaluator must be constructed with an existing feature. * * [2] The application should edit the properties "CreateCurveOption", "SimplifyCurveOption" * as needed before calling this method. * * Post-conditions: * [3] If the "create curve" option is set to false, the output curves should be * accessed right away. * The lifetime of these curves is as long as the next call to method "EvaluateOneSketch". * * [4] If the application wants to evaluate the same sketch at multiple path location, * it should make several consecutive calls to method "EvaluateOneSketch". * At the end of the operation, the application must call method "Destroy". * * [5] If the "simplify curve" option is false, the number of curves will always be the same. * * [6] The design of this functionality has not been tailored for master section * with multiple loops. If the master section has multiple loops, all the curves * will be returned in the order of the loops in the section. * * [7] Method "EvaluateOneSketch" changes the state of the sketch on path. Therefore, * the part is temporarily in out of date state. The application should leverage * the NX undo mechanism to reset the state to its original. An alternative solution * is to suppress and unsuppress the sketch on path and variational sweep features * involved.
Created in NX4.0.1
License requirements: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING")
member.param: input path arc length percent to evaluate at.

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchMakeSymmetricBuilder.CenterLine
member.summary: Returns the function returns the center line of a symmetric constraint.
member.remarks:
This must be a straight line, straight edge, datum axis or datum plane. If the centerline is line, edge or datum axis, it is not perpendicular to the sketch plane. If the centerline is datum plane, it is not parallel to the sketch plane. If an entity is selected that is not part of sketch, it will be projected on the sketch plane and the projection will be used as the center line.
Created in NX7.5.0
License requirements: None.

member.summary: This function helps to turn on or off relation finding on a particular instance.
member.remarks:
Index of 0,0 corresponds to the base/input to the pattern. Y-index for non-rectangular patterns should be 0. This function can be called for any relation scope. But if the scope is not set to NXOpen.SketchPattern.RelationScope.Specified at the time of commit, the indices set here would be ignored.
Created in NX2212.0.0
License requirements: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR drafting ("DRAFTING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")
member.param: True to find relations from the instance, false to exclude the instance from relation finding

member.name: M:NXOpen.SketchPatternBuilder.GetRelationFinding(System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: This function queries the find setting on an instance.
member.remarks:
If the return value is true, then the relations will be found on that instance. Index of 0, 0 corresponds to the base/input to the pattern. Y-index for non-rectangular patterns should be 0. If this function is called for any scope other than NXOpen.SketchPattern.RelationScope.Specified , the result will always be set to false.
Created in NX2212.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.returns: True if relations are found from the instance, false if excluded from relation finding

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchProjectBuilder.Associativity
member.summary: Returns or sets the associativity of projection.
member.remarks:
If this variable is turned on, the output curves will always depend on the input curves. So that when the input curves change, the output curves will change accordingly. If this variable is set to false, the output curves derive their shape from current stage of the input curves and then become independent of the input curves. In drafting mode, one can not project curves in associative manner. Also if the curves belong to multiple parts, they can not be projected in associative manner.
Created in NX5.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchProjectBuilder.CurveList
member.summary: Returns the curve list.
member.remarks:
The curves to project should be added to this list only if they belong to multiple parts and they are to be projected in non associative manner. All the curves to be projected should either go to the section or the curve list depending on their owning parts.
Created in NX5.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchProjectBuilder.CurveType
member.summary: Returns or sets the output curve type generated by the projection.
member.remarks:
Depending on this value, the projected curve can have the same geometry as the input curves or it can be a single spline curve or a set of splines.
Created in NX5.0.0
License requirements to get this property: None.
License requirements to set this property: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")

member.name: P:NXOpen.SketchProjectBuilder.ProjectAsDumbFixedCurves
member.summary: Returns or sets the flag to indicate if the projection output needs to be converted to dumb fully fixed curves in the sketch.
member.remarks:
This flag overrides the associativity flag i.e. if both projectAsDumbFixed and associativity are set to true, the result will be dumb fixed curves and not an associative projection.
Created in NX7.5.0
License requirements to get this property: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")
License requirements to set this property: solid_modeling ("SOLIDS MODELING") OR geometric_tol ("GDT")

member.name: M:NXOpen.SmartObject.Evaluate
member.summary: Evaluate a smart object.
member.remarks:
Typically smart object should be logged for update and final update should be performed at correct time so that smart object is processed with all its dependencies. In some situations, such as after replacing parameters of smart object, if it needs to be used immediately without performing final update, it may be forced to evaluate. When evaluate is called, smart object is evaluated based on current state of its parents and its children are not affected.

member.name: T:NXOpen.SpreadsheetCellData
member.summary: Represents a class for Spreadsheet cell data.
member.remarks:
The data type held in the cell can be obtained from the NXOpen.SpreadsheetCellData.Type . And then the value can obtained from the correct accessor. The value and type of the cell will be changed when calling the set methods. That is if a cell was a formula, but the NXOpen.SpreadsheetCellData.DoubleValue is called, the type will be changed as well.
It should be noted the cell value on the sheet will not updated, by calling a set method on this class. The object must then be passed into the appropriate method on NXOpen.SpreadsheetManager .
Usable only on Windows
Created in NX11.0.0

member.name: M:NXOpen.SpreadsheetManager.OpenFile(System.String,NXOpen.SpreadsheetManager.OpenMode)
member.summary: Opens an Excel spreadsheet file.
member.remarks:
The type of the access mode can be either Read, or Write. The Excel spreadsheet to be opened could be either from the native file system, or from the dataset file stored in the Teamcenter database. It requires an active work part.
Note: For dataset file stored in the Teamcenter database, the spreadsheet must be stored as a MSExcel or MSExcelX dataset. The dataset shall be attached to its containing item revision with an IMAN_specification relation. Up to one MSExcel or MSExcelX dataset can be attached.
Usable only on Windows
Created in NX11.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.returns: Returns a SpreadsheetExternal object to be used to access the external spreadsheet.

member.name: M:NXOpen.SpreadsheetManager.ExportFile(System.String)
member.summary: In NX/MGR mode, export an Excel spreadsheet file from the dataset file stored in the Teamcenter database to the native file system.
member.remarks:
The file is exported for reading only.
Note: For dataset file stored in the Teamcenter database, the spreadsheet must be stored as a MSExcel or MSExcelX dataset. The dataset shall be attached to its containing item revision with an IMAN_specification relation. Up to one MSExcel or MSExcelX dataset can be attached.
Usable only on Windows
Created in NX11.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: A part number containing a MsExcel dataset.
member.returns:
If the file is exported successfully, the function returns a string indicating the full file name in native file system. If the file failed to export, the function returns empty string indicating no native file available.
In Native mode, it does nothing and always returns an empty string.

For create each and create shared options, the selected features must not have pre existing suppress expressions. For delete each option, the selected features must have associated suppress expressions. If the expression is being shared by multiple features, the expression will be deleted only for the selected feature. For delete shared option, the complete group that shares a single expression must be selected.

member.name: P:NXOpen.SuppressByExpressionBuilder.SuppressAction
member.summary: Returns or sets the suppress expression action.
member.remarks:
This enumeration decides the action to be taken on the selected group of features. A suppress expression can created per feature or as shared expression for a group of features. The expressions can be deleted individually for all features that have suppress expressions associated. For a group of features sharing an expression, the expression can also be deleted from the whole group.
Created in NX5.0.0

member.name: T:NXOpen.UnitCollection.UnitDefaults
member.summary: Specifies a set of units to be used as defaults for data entry or object information For each measure, a unit type will be selected that matches the specified choice.
member.remarks:
The choice affects these dimensions: Lenth Mass Force Angle Temperature Delta Temperature
These dimensions are not affected: Electric Charge (A-sec) Luminous Intensity (cd) Amount of Substance (mol)
NOTE: Only the SI unit set is an internally consistent set of units. For example, the unit for Force (N) is used in all the metric sets, but since it's defined as kg*m/s^2, it's compatible only with kg and m, which are used in the SI set. Similarly, the unit deg is used for all the sets except the SI set.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Update.StartLocalUpdate
member.summary: Starts a local update session, and sets an update mark for that session.
member.remarks:
This ensures that only entities added into update list since the mark setting are updated when the next update is performed before the mark is cleared. To perform update,use NXOpen.Update.DoUpdate . To clear the mark, use NXOpen.Update.EndLocalUpdate .
Note:
Any entities updated while the mark was in place will not be updated during the next update even if they depend on entities on the newly restored list.
Local update may not be nested.i.e.if a local update process is started and not yet ended, you cannot start another one.
Created in NX7.5.1
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.Update.SetUpdateLock(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Sets the update lock to lock and unlock updates.
member.remarks:
Locking updates will lock model updates until updates are unlocked. Note that updates should be locked with utmost care as operations can produce undesired results or possibly result in unexpected failures when they are performed when updates are locked.
If you do choose to lock updates then you have to ensure that the update lock state prior to locking update is restored after your operation. See NXOpen.Update.GetUpdateLock to get the lock status. Additionally, a call to NXOpen.Update.DoUpdate has to be made after restoring the lock status to ensure that entities added to the update list after update was locked are updated.
Created in NX7.5.5
License requirements: None.

member.summary: Gets the update lock status.
member.remarks:
Also see NXOpen.Update.SetUpdateLock

In batch mode, the translation of the view is modified, but no display occurs

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Concatenate(System.Double)
member.summary: Concatenates the given scale with the previous viewing transformation of the specified view.
member.remarks:
The scale is applied to the view using the current view origin.
In batch mode, the scale of the view is modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Concatenate(NXOpen.Point3d,System.Double)
member.summary: Concatenates the given translation and scale with the previous viewing transformation of the specified view.
member.remarks:
The translation is defined in view space, and conceptually occurs first. Then, the scale is applied to the view using the new view origin. Although this is logically a two step process, only the final result appears in the graphics window.
In batch mode, the translation and scale of the view are modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Point in view space to put at the center of the view

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Concatenate(NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Vector3d,System.Double)
member.summary: Concatenates the given rotation with the previous viewing transformation of the specified view.
member.remarks:
First, if a center of rotation is given, a translation occurs to move the center of the view to the center of rotation. Then, the rotation occurs about the center of rotation. Finally, if a center of rotation is being used, the view is translated back to the origin it had upon entering the function. Although this is logically a three step process, only the final result appears in the graphics window.
In batch mode, the rotation of the view is modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: If not NULL, this specifies a point in view space about which the view is to be rotated

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Concatenate(NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Vector3d,System.Double)
member.summary: Concatenates the given translation and rotation with the previous viewing transformation of the specified view.
member.remarks:
The translation is defined in view space, and conceptually occurs first. Then, if a center of rotation is given, a translation occurs to move the center of the view to the center of rotation. Third, the rotation occurs about the center of rotation. Finally, if a center of rotation is being used, the view is translated back to the origin it had after the translation. Although this is logically a four step process, only the final result appears in the graphics window.
In batch mode, the translation and rotation of the view are modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Point in view space to put at the center of the view
If not NULL, this specifies a point in view space about which the view is to be rotated

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Concatenate(System.Double,NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Vector3d,System.Double)
member.summary: Concatenates the given scale and rotation with the previous viewing transformation of the specified view.
member.remarks:
First, the scale is applied to the view using the current view origin. Then, if a center of rotation is given, a translation occurs to move the center of the view to the center of rotation. Third, the rotation occurs about the center of rotation. Finally, if a center of rotation is being used, the view is translated back to the origin it had upon entering the function. Although this is logically a four step process, only the final result appears in the graphics window.
In batch mode, the scale and rotation of the view are modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: If not NULL, this specifies a point in view space about which the view is to be rotated

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Concatenate(NXOpen.Point3d,System.Double,NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Vector3d,System.Double)
member.summary: Concatenates the given translation, scale and rotation with the previous viewing transformation of the specified view.
member.remarks:
The translation is defined in view space, and conceptually occurs first. Then the scale is applied to the view using the newly defined center. Third, a translation occurs to move the center of the view to the center of rotation (if any). Fourth, the rotation occurs about the center of rotation. Finally, if a center of rotation is being used, the view is translated back to its origin as specified by the first argument. Although this is logically a five step process, only the final result appears in the graphics window.
In batch mode, the translation, scale and rotation of the view are modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Point in view space to put at the center of the view
If not NULL, this specifies a point in view space about which the view is to be rotated

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Expand
member.summary: Expands the specified view to fill as much of the layout which contains the view as possible, without changing the aspect ratio of the view.
member.remarks:
Other views in the layout are no longer displayed. The view becomes the work view. A view that is not displayed cannot be expanded.
In batch mode, the data for the view is changed to reflect that the view is expanded, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Fit
member.summary: Adjusts the bounds of a given view so that it fully encompasses the extents of the model geometry.
member.remarks:
If the view is displayed, the changes will appear in the display of that view, and, if enabled, the change in the bounds of the view is animated.
In batch mode, the data for the bounds of the view are changed to the adjusted bounds, but no display occurs.
Created in NX3.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.FitAfterShowOrHide(NXOpen.View.ShowOrHideType)
member.summary: Adjusts the bounds of a given view conditionally so that it fully encompasses the extents of the model geometry.
member.remarks:
This method is intended to be used only immediately after a show or hide operation has been done. The fit operation is performed only if the "Fit on Show or Hide" option is enabled by NXOpen.Preferences.SessionVisualizationScreen.DoFitOnHideOrShow , and if the work view is not a drawing view. If only a hide operation has been done and a fit would cause the view scale to decrease, the fit will not be done. If the view is displayed, the changes will appear in the display of that view, and, if enabled, the change in the bounds of the view is animated.
In batch mode, the data for the bounds of the view may be changed to the adjusted bounds, if the "Fit on Show or Hide" option is enabled and the other conditions are met, but no display occurs.
Created in NX8.5.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: Whether a Show or Hide or both has been done

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.SetRotationTranslationScale(NXOpen.Matrix3x3,NXOpen.Point3d,System.Double)
member.summary: Sets the rotation, translation and scale of the specified view.
member.remarks:
The rotation is applied first, about the absolute origin. Then the translation of the "look at" point to the view center is done, then the view is scaled about the view center.

member.summary: Changes the orientation of the given view to the orientation of the canned view whose orientation is the closest to that of the given view.
member.remarks:

In batch mode, the orientation of the view is changed internally, but no display occurs.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.SnapToVariantCannedOrientation
member.summary: Similar to NXOpen.View.SnapToClosestCannedOrientation except it changes the orientation of the given view to the orientation of some canned view "variant" based on I-deas's 'snapview' logic whose orientation is the closest to one of the six orthographic and eight flavors of trimetric views.

remarks.para: In batch mode, the orientation of the view is changed internally, but no display occurs.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.UpdateDisplay
member.summary: Updates the display of given view, as needed.
member.remarks:
The current scale of the view is used to determine the tessalation of curves, facets and software line fonts. The view must be already displayed.
In batch mode, internal state information is updated, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.Zoom(NXOpen.View.ScaleFactor)
member.summary: Scales the specified view to a desired relative scale.
member.remarks:
The "reduce" and "increase" scale options are fixed at 10%. All the scale options provided by NXOpen.View.ScaleFactor have an internal limiting factor. This scale can't be increased or decreased indefinitely. The change in view scale is not animated.
In batch mode, the scale of the view is modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX3.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.ZoomAboutPoint(System.Double,NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Scales the specified view such that the given scale_about_point does not move.
member.remarks:
If the specified scale is extremely small or extremely large, a minimum or maximum scale will be used. These are the same minimum and maximum values as used interactively. The relative_scale will be concatenated to the current scale of the view, so that 1.0 means no change of scale and 2.0 means that the scale of the view will be doubled. The scale_about_point and current_view_center are given in View Space. The view must already be displayed.
In batch mode, the scale and translation of the view are modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: The point to remain stationary, in View Space
The point to be considered as the view center, in View Space. This may be NULL, in which case the current view center is used.

member.name: M:NXOpen.View.ZoomByRectangle(NXOpen.Point3d,NXOpen.Point3d)
member.summary: Scales the specified view such that the specified rectangle is as large as possible while being fully contained within the viewport.
member.remarks:
If the rectangle and the viewport do not have the same aspect ratio, the viewport will contain some of the view not within the rectangle. If the rectangle is extremely small or extremely large, a minimum or maximum scale will be used. These are the same minimum and maximum values as used interactively. The two opposite corners of the rectangle are given in View Space. The view must already be displayed. If enabled, the change in the bounds of the view is animated.
In batch mode, the scale and translation of the view are modified, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.
member.param: One corner of the rectangle, in View Space
The opposite corner of the rectangle, in View Space

member.summary: Finds the NXOpen.View with the given identifier as recorded in a journal.
member.remarks:
An object may not return the same value as its JournalIdentifier in different versions of the software. However newer versions of the software should find the same object when FindObject is passed older versions of its journal identifier. In general, this method should not be used in handwritten code and exists to support record and playback of journals.
An exception will be thrown if no object can be found with the given journal identifier.

member.name: M:NXOpen.ViewCollection.UnexpandWork
member.summary: Removes the work view from the expand state (assuming that it is in that state), restoring it to its normal size in its layout.
member.remarks:
Other views in the layout become visible again. If the work view is not in expand state, an error is returned. The view remains the work view unless the view is a member view on a drawing sheet, in which case the sheet's view becomes the work view. The given part must be the displayed part.
In batch mode, the internal state of the view is no longer in expand state, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.ViewCollection.FitAll
member.summary: Adjusts the center and scale of each view in the current layout such that all of each view is visible, except that this fit operation is not applied to member views on a drawing.
member.remarks:
If the work view is in expand state when this method is called, the work view is unexpanded before all of the views are fit.
In batch mode, the data for each view is updated, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.ViewCollection.Regenerate
member.summary: Regenerates the display of each view in the current layout.
member.remarks:
The current scale of each view is used in determing the tolerances for rendering curves and facets within the view.
In batch mode, the state of each view is updated, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.ViewCollection.UpdateDisplay
member.summary: Updates the display of each view in the current layout.
member.remarks:
This method redisplays those objects whose display has become out of date due to rotations of the view or increases in view scale. For example: Following a rotation, the silhouettes of bodies in wireframe mode will be updated; Following a significant scale increase, the faces of a body in shaded mode will be tessalated with tighter tolerances.
In batch mode, the state of each view is updated, but no display occurs.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.name: M:NXOpen.XformCollection.CreateXform(NXOpen.IPlaneForXformByThreePlanes,NXOpen.IPlaneForXformByThreePlanes,NXOpen.IPlaneForXformByThreePlanes,NXOpen.SmartObject.UpdateOption,System.Double)
member.summary: Creates an Xform by three planes.
member.remarks:
Defines an xform based on the input of three planes. These can be either planar faces, datum planes or plane objects. The X-Axis is normal of the first plane, the Y-Axis is normal of the second plane, the origin is the intersection of the three plane. The plane can either be a planar NXOpen.Face , a NXOpen.DatumPlane or a a NXOpen.Plane . If the xform is to be used to create a CSYS, then the planes should be NXOpen.Plane objects.
Created in NX3.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.summary: Creates an Xform through a point and perpendicular to a curve or edge.
member.remarks:
The Z-axis is tangent to the curve or edge, and the X-Y plane goes through the point. When you select a linear curve, the X-Axis is a perpendicular vector from the curve to the point. When you select a non-linear curve, the X-Axis points in an arbitrary orientation and not towards the selected point.

member.name: M:NXOpen.XformCollection.CreateXformFromCurrentView(NXOpen.SmartObject.UpdateOption,System.Double)
member.summary: Creates an XForm using the current viewing coordinate system.
member.remarks:
The X-Axis is parallel to the bottom of the view, the Y-Axis is parallel to the side of the view, and the origin is the origin of the view (the middle of the graphics screen). The coordinate system uses the right-hand rule so the Z-axis points out of the screen. Since the current viewing coordinate system does not exist if the NX session is running in batch mode, the absolute coordinate system will be returned instead.
Created in NX4.0.0
License requirements: None.

member.summary: Creates an Xform from the Xform of a selected curve, plane, or drafting object.
member.remarks:
If the selected curve is non-planar an error will be thrown. If the curve is an arc, ellipse, hyperbola, parabola, or circle, the origin will be at the respective curve's center. If the object is a planar face or a datum plane, the Z-axis is the normal vector of the plane.
Created in NX5.0.0

member.name: M:NXOpen.XformCollection.CreateXformCsysToCsys(NXOpen.CoordinateSystem,NXOpen.CoordinateSystem,NXOpen.SmartObject.UpdateOption)
member.summary: Creates a Motion Xform based on two CSYS.

remarks.para: CsysToCsys is a reposition between two coordinate systems such that the objects are moved until the first CSYS aligns with the second CSYS.
[Xform1] is the matrix of the first CSYS. [Xform2] is the matrix of the second CSYS. [Motion Xform] is the matrix of result Motion Xform.
Note: the matrix is column oriented in NX. That is, Xform matrices look like:
(Xx, Xy, Xz) is X axis direction. (Yx, Yy, Yz) is Y axis direction. (Zx, Zy, Zz) is Z axis direction. (X, Y, Z) is origin position.
